rules.statement: Agent and application containers do not receive the Docker socket.
rules.title: Application containers do not receive the Docker socket
rules.why: Prevents application runtimes from gaining Docker control-plane authority.

rules.statement: Runtime credentials stay outside Git, images and authored Compose definitions. Applications may use their native persistent secret store; environment-based credentials use a protected untracked file with mode `600`, scoped to the intended application.
rules.title: Runtime credentials use protected local storage
rules.why: Preserves native provider configuration while avoiding implicit sharing of credentials between unrelated applications.
